definitions: To have clothing, jewellery, etc. on your body.
To damage something by using it a lot or for a long time, or to be damaged in this way.
To gradually make a hole or mark in something, or to be made in this way.
To have a particular expression on your face.
To tolerate something or someone over time.
examples: She was wearing a beautiful dress.
The carpet is starting to wear thin.
The constant criticism began to wear on her.
